description: Reputation and payments for Binance Agent ID holders, on BNB Chain. AgentStreak records daily check-in streaks and a public reputation score for verified Agent ID holders; AgentPay settles payment requests addressed to Agent ID holders without custody; the AgentId8004Bridge publishes that track record into the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry as standard feedback, so any agent application can read it.
name: Agent Streak + AgentPay
